page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; one text column at right; marginal notes in the left margin beside the text (three notes); a heading block and a catchword-free foot.

main_text.p: nostras, iram Dei uertamus tandem in misericordiam. Id fiet si uita in me lius correcta, uitia in uirtutes ipsi pri us commutabimus. Verum hac de re alius erit (Christo permittente) dis seredi locus. Nunc ad fautores Vuiclei redeamus: quibus praeterea accensetur D. Cobhamus, qui aperteD. Cobham. profiteri auditus est, quemadmodum ex Vualdeno autore constat, peccatum se nunquam ex animo odisse, priusquam Vuicleui doctrina hac imbueretur. Atque hi primarij quidem omnes. Nec deerant etiam apud ignobiles, qui dogmata illius obnixius propugnarent, sed potissimum Oxonienses, e quibus nullus tamenOxonienses Vuicleui asserto-res. fine aliquo stigmate immunis euasit, quin ad palinodiam aut sit adactus turpiter, aut ad ignem crudeliter adiudicatus.
main_text.head: DE ROB. RYGGAEO CANCELLARIO. Herfordo. & Ph. Repyngtono.

page.notes: Marginal notes read: "D. Cobhamus." beside "profiteri"; "Oxonienses Vuicleui asserto-res." beside "Oxonienses". The running head and heading line are partly damaged; the catchword "pyn-" is printed at the foot right. Some words in the heading are uncertain.
